mentions.name: Sevro
mentions.description: Sevro is a node-based image editing and graphic design tool that brings procedural workflows to graphic design, enabling generative branding systems, parametric identities, and posters. It runs in the browser with no login and no tracking.
mentions.audience: Graphic designers interested in procedural, generative branding and poster design
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a node based image editing / graphic design tool called Sevro

The hope is that I can bring more procedural workflows to graphic design so you can make generative branding systems and parametric identities

(or just make sick posters)

you can try it in the browser, no login no tracking
